v3 = Base.Vector(25, 15, 0)
v4 = Base.Vector(-25, 15, 0)

g1 = sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v2, v3), False)
g2 = sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v3, v4), False)
g3 = sketch.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(v4, v1), False)

# Coincident constraints
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", g0, 1, g1, 0))
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", g1, 1, g2, 0))
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", g2, 1, g3, 0))
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", g3, 1, g0, 0))

# Horizontal constraint
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Horizontal", g0))

# Distance constraints (50mm width, 30mm height)
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance", g0, 50.0))
sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Distance", g1, 30.0))

sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("PointOnObject", g0, 0, 0))
